child_tool_info.instructions:
Operation: result.blast.hsp

Read a selected alignment-column window of one explicitly received BLAST HSP. Return native symbols, residue/nucleotide intervals, frames and directions, paired/substituted/gap counts and identity/coverage with explicit denominators. Retain the complete numerical sheet; whole-HSP scores retain their original meaning. Host-bound received inputs and original source custody are required. This reads retained results without executing a search or acquiring a reference sequence.

Use the actual local binding and its caller-owned resource limits. Read or measure only the assigned operands and explicit received inputs. Reuse retained outputs when the operation is a read; do not treat a read as a new measurement. Preserve native values, coordinate meanings, partial results and actionable failures. Job-specific operations require their original assigned execution.

Use exactly the separately supplied actual input_schema; required operands and allowed values come from that contract. Do not infer another callable, resource or environment from this entry.

# Selected columns from a retained BLAST HSP

`result.blast.hsp` reads one explicitly received HSP observation. Supply its
`observation_ref`, a zero-based `column_offset`, and a `column_limit` from 1 to
4096. These coordinates select alignment columns, including gaps. They are
different from query or reference sequence positions. Offset equal to the
available alignment length returns an empty terminal page; a larger offset is
invalid. The selected observation and its complete original HSP must lie within
the assigned scope and be present in the child's received inputs.

This is a supplied-result read in the scientific child. It uses retained NCBI
BLAST JSON HSP data or an actual retained native paired BLAST JSON15 or declared
tabular HSP from the authenticated original result, covering blastn,
blastp, blastx, tblastn and tblastx. It launches no alignment or database search,
acquires no full reference sequence, and selects no alternative HSP or resource.
The original API execution and its submission ancestry remain separate facts.
Native paired observations retain their own bundle, captured report, original
search/hit/HSP ordinals and complete original operands. They do not acquire an
API request or RID. JSON translated negative frames can have ascending native
endpoints; tabular endpoints are directional. The retained actual format
determines this interpretation, including when recalculating a saved sheet.

The response preserves the requested native string window, its realized extent,
the total available columns and the next offset when another page exists.
Column correspondence includes both native symbols, zero-based half-open
intervals in the original query/reference operands, their explicit units, and
the reported frame and strand. A translated amino-acid column consumes three
nucleotide units on that translated operand. Reverse intervals keep ascending
bounds and a separate direction. Native amino-acid symbols do not reconstruct
nucleotides. A gap has no corresponding interval. Separately supplied original
derivation mappings can retain ordered split codons, repeated segments and
source orientation; absent ancestry remains unavailable.

Selected-window measurements count paired columns, identical uppercase native
symbol pairs, substitutions and each operand's gap columns. Literal equality
of an ambiguity symbol does not resolve its underlying residue. Paired identity
uses the paired-column denominator; alignment identity uses all selected
columns. Paired coverage uses the union of checked paired intervals divided by
the complete corresponding operand length in its native units. Every ratio
retains its numerator and denominator. Native bit score, alignment score and
E-value retain their whole-HSP meaning and do not enter these window ratios.

Missing strings give unavailable window counts. Readable strings with invalid
coordinates can retain string counts while positional coverage is unavailable.
Reported extent or midline conflicts also prevent checked positional mapping.
An empty terminal window has zero counts and null identity. A measured zero
score remains zero. Complete native input, sheet and separate calculator output
are retained for recalculation; return only the requested bounded facts.

Reading and calculation create no new scientific source or observation, no
annotation confidence and no separate credit. Original HSP measurements and
prior history remain unchanged. Repeated representations or separate pages do
not become independent scientific evidence.

evidence_axis.investigation_instructions:
Determine what functions the supplied gene or protein may perform by comparing its sequence with relevant homologs and family profiles. Start from the supplied sequence, selected file record or region, or snippets. No candidate annotation or searchable public name is required. Preserve the selected material and its boundaries; do not infer a complete sequence from snippets or choose an arbitrary record from a multi-record file.

Use the comparisons to identify plausible families and distinguish their functions. Examine what was experimentally characterized in relevant homologs, including close relatives with different functions, and map the features bearing on those differences to the supplied target. Retain the identity of the experimentally studied subject separately from the sequence or profile used in a search. A database description or inherited family label is not experimental characterization.

Retain actual alignment or profile scores, bit scores, E-values, identity, matched spans and coverage when available, with the method, search space, score units, denominators and reported uncertainty or bounds. Keep query and comparator coverage distinct, and distinguish a matched domain from the whole protein. Compare numbers only where their methods and scales permit the comparison; a sequence score is not a probability of a particular function.

Examine catalytic and recognition residues, missing or additional domains, and substitutions or insertions that distinguish possible activities. High overall identity can coexist with different substrate specificity; a short match or conserved cofactor-binding region can support only a broader conclusion. Preserve negative results, function-changing differences and unresolved regions. Revise the possible functions as the comparisons become informative, keeping family membership, exact reaction, substrate specificity and physiological role distinct.
evidence_axis.name: Sequence homology

thought_pattern.boundary: Choose a comparator for transfer of a disputed biological property. P02 instead tests an explicit feature-to-function implication against discordant cases. A better sequence score, fold match or neighborhood is a tool result, not the transfer conclusion.
decision_guidance: Prefer references that separate plausible alternatives, not simply the most familiar name or highest global score. Alignments, structures and context searches are ways to inspect a chosen relationship.
When a comparison is weak, consider a biologically better reference before treating it as evidence against all relationship.
Keep catalytic compatibility, target recognition and native role as separate transfer claims; absent catalytic machinery can overturn an inherited chemistry.
thought_pattern.description: Use similarity to a characterized system to form bounded explanations. Choose which sequence, local structural machinery, domain architecture, genomic context or organismal circumstance makes the reference informative for the disputed property; revise misleading comparators.
live_alternatives: A relevant shared relationship supports transfer of the disputed property.
Only a partial core is shared; recognition, partners or role differ.
The comparator or short match is uninformative for this question.
thought_pattern.name: Choose a relevant analogue and bound what transfers

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Relevant machinery corresponds but specificity differs
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain the supported relationship and investigate the differing recognition or contextual features.
Reopen chemistry and preserve only the relationship actually supported.
Keep function unresolved; absence of an informative match is not absence of function.

thought_pattern.use_when: A nearest hit, fold, motif or similar biological context suggests an annotation, but exact chemistry, recognition or role remains open.

tools.description: Read one instruction entry's section index, tool names and provenance without loading manual bodies. A listed tool is not necessarily enabled for this episode.
tools.name: knowledge.entry

tools.description: Read a selected instruction section by zero-based line offset and line count. Follow next_query for more. Returns run library identity and exact section digest; instructions are not scientific source evidence.
tools.name: knowledge.read

tools.description: Search/page the separate run-frozen launch instruction metadata. Empty query browses entries. resource_kind is an optional exact metadata filter; neither matches nor manuals establish resource availability.
tools.name: launch.instructions.search

tools.description: Read one launch instruction entry index, sources and section hashes without loading section text. Listed operations still require an actual binding.
tools.name: launch.instructions.entry

tools.description: Read exact zero-based line windows from a selected launch instruction section. Returns its digest and next_query; reading performs no setup or execution.
tools.name: launch.instructions.read

tools.description: Pin explicitly selected sections from one or multiple entries in this run-frozen launch library. Pass the returned selection as the child assignment launch_instructions. Does not choose or launch a resource.
tools.name: launch.instructions.select

tools.description: Search/page frozen evidence-axis and thought-pattern options. process.entry supplies investigation guidance about the evidence and measurements to examine. Discovery selects no work and grants no capabilities.
tools.name: process.search

tools.description: Read investigation guidance for an evidence axis or the selected thought-pattern instructions by A/P option ID. Evidence-axis lookups describe measurements and their limits; scoring sheets, grading recipes and reader bindings are separate. The parent retains its return form.
tools.name: process.entry

tools.description: Page the instruction provenance supporting a fully pinned option. Case evidence and E identifiers are library provenance, not new scientific observations.
tools.name: process.sources

tools.description: Retrieve actual operation information for the desired child investigation. Parent rows contain name, description and one API/local/HPC resource kind. Select by name plus resources; the host supplies matching frozen instructions and the actual invocation contract to the child. Never compose descriptions or instructions. This retrieval performs no scientific work or child launch.
tools.name: process.tools

tools.description: Inspect the supported estimate for a proposed wait using your received progress, original duration snapshots and completed own-action history. Unknown event probabilities and gains remain unknown. This tool selects no wait, timer, resource or work.
tools.name: episode.estimate_wait

tools.description: Read only this Episode's prior decisions: metadata index, exact selected actions/outcomes and admitted direct-child forms, or a bounded publication-ID page from one prior own action. Failed outcomes remain failed. This ordinary read never executes old work or reads child-private conversations.

limit.description: Requested page size; defaults to max(1, restoration preview_size), so disabling automatic previews still permits an ordinary page to advance. Omit when selecting decision_indices.

offset.description: Position in this Episode's ordered prior-decision page; omit when selecting decision_indices.

limit.description: Requested publication-ID page size; defaults to max(1, restoration preview_size).

offset.description: Position in the actual saved publication-ID array for this one prior own action.

tools.name: episode.history

credit_binding.meaning: Caller-injected projector; no default scientific policy or denominator is inferred.
